Stop waiting to be rich to build s*x appeal.

It's the lie every broke guy tells himself.

'When I'm rich, I'll get fit.'
'When I'm loaded, girls will notice me.'
'When I'm successful, I'll be confident.'

The guy with nothing is already jacked. Funny. Visible.

The broke guy who builds beats the rich guy who waits. Every time.

Your s*x appeal costs time, not cash. You build it now, or you don't build it.

Start today. In 90 days you won't recognize yourself.
